reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

I got this from #central-team, which she's a member of. On 9 June 2026 she posted there that the Pine Crossing morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login.

I didn't find any later message in that channel saying it was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before marking it resolved on the account sheet. To find this I only read #central-team and two Central team files that anyone can open.
